title: Information or form help?
hook: Is knowing aid exists the same as completing its application?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Distinguish an information intervention from assistance that removes application steps.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Distinguish an information intervention from assistance that removes application steps.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy application has four required steps taking five minutes each. Information alone removes no steps. How long does completing it take? Toy inputs A=[4, 5]; B=[1, 5].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[20, 4, 5], [5, 1, 5]]. Labels: Minutes, Steps, Min/step.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: Information and hands-on assistance are distinct interventions. The comparison removes three procedural steps and therefore reduces the stated completion time. Whether this translates into enrollment is a separate empirical outcome.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Required steps=1, Minutes/step=5. What is Minutes? Answer: 5.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Required steps=1, Minutes/step=5. What is Minutes?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 5. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Having tax preparers fill out the FAFSA aid form raised college enrollment from 28% to 36% (Bettinger, Long, Oreopoulos & Sanbonmatsu, 2012).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Distinguish an information intervention from assistance that removes application steps.
